# Copilot / Coding Agent Instructions

Majlis is a spec-first Flutter + .NET production product. Before editing code, follow the complete `AGENTS.md` read order, including `docs/product/v1-product-decisions.md`, `specs/003-production-app/`, the API/schema contracts, traceability matrix, and the relevant feature folder under `specs/`.

Use minimal diffs. Implement one task at a time, but treat each task as progress toward the complete running Android app rather than a reduced delivery boundary. Preserve product intent: daily Arab cultural challenge, respectful competition, cultural authenticity, and safe community interaction.

After every task, update `docs/ai-context/HANDOFF.md`.
